headSubject: chore(ledger): OWN-2 section 5.2 domain-fit simulation run; file its findings REG-312..318, SEC-16
summary: Owner decisions: BUILD-4 WONTFIX (stay on Boot 3.5.16, exposure recorded), AIP-7 WONTFIX (legacy http kind stays; AIP-2 narrowed). Closed RUN-37 and AIP-4 live in the real Manager window (driven over WebView2 CDP): Docker Postgres found and adopted via Find databases > Use this; real prompts via AI Providers (gemini, groq). Found and fixed MON-33 (every Manager tab unreadable: unscoped .screen CSS + dark tabs missing palette tokens + tab bar overflow), Manager 0.5.4, guard tests proven red. Ran OWN-2 section 5.2 domain-fit simulation via a fresh agent (clinical-trial scheduler): working app, wall = no date arithmetic; filed REG-312..318 and SEC-16. Pushed fb972de3, dc8b3396.
nextStep: Fix the simulation's HIGH findings, cheapest first: (1) REG-314 -- read NpdevAuthConfig/the api-key resolver for the real npdev.auth.api-keys grammar and rewrite docs/CONFIGURATION.md:85 with an example; (2) REG-312 -- reproduce GET /api/concepts/<SingularConcept> on a booted sample first, then fix the route or the doc + OpenAPI with a REST test; (3) REG-313 part (a) -- make the validator refuse non-numeric computeValue operands with a coded diagnostic (date functions are part (b), owner may defer). Then SEC-16 (write rule must also check the new row). OWN-2 stays open for the owner's 5.1 conversations only.
verified: aiKnowledge gate green 52/52 (before dc8b3396, which is ledger-only; ledger checks re-run green after it). Manager cargo test 57/57; test_db_discovery 30/30; check-done-item-guards 0 blocking. Real-window evidence: NPDev_General__OutsideRepo/evidence/2026-10-28-run37-aip4-manager-window/.
